nodes.label: Booked table tile writes booking name and party/seats (5/6) at every size
nodes.norm_label: booked table tile writes booking name and party/seats (5/6) at every size
nodes.rationale: Fitted to the till's 1024x768, every table of the restaurant's 1800x1100 room was drawn below the size at which a tile wrote its booking, so a booked table only turned orange. The text shrinks first (table name down to 11 px, booking down to 10) and only then is the name cut at its end; widths are measured in the page's own font rather than guessed from the letter count. The booking time is on the booking sheet, no longer on the map.

nodes.label: Change table / Take off this table on a booked table's card
nodes.norm_label: change table / take off this table on a booked table's card
nodes.rationale: A party asking for another table is an everyday thing, and moving a booking meant going to the booking sheet. Change table picks the booking up so the next table tapped on the map takes it (a swap when that table is booked too, the row above the map saying 'Tap the new table for Rossi' with Cancel as the way out, a tap on its own table changing nothing); Take off this table sends it back to the bookings still to seat. Edit booking and Cancel booking moved into the same box, the card's foot keeping what concerns the table itself. Both go through the sheet's own POST /api/reservations/:id/assign.

nodes.label: Back to the floor from the booking sheet
nodes.norm_label: back to the floor from the booking sheet
nodes.rationale: Back to the floor sits where the floor has Bookings, and the sidebar keeps Floor lit while the sheet is open.

nodes.label: Service map fitted to the tables, not the walls
nodes.norm_label: service map fitted to the tables, not the walls
nodes.rationale: The empty edges of a room shrank every table with them. Service now frames where the tables stand plus a margin, so the restaurant's room is drawn about a fifth bigger; edit mode still shows the whole room, where tables get dragged to.

nodes.label: Small table size removed (migration v98)
nodes.norm_label: small table size removed (migration v98)
nodes.rationale: A table drawn at 110 units had no room on the till for its booking under its name. The size picker offers Medium, Large and Banquet, and a two-top is drawn medium. Migration v98 makes the tables still that size medium (150x110 lying down, 110x150 standing, 140 across if round), growing from the corner they are placed by, and does the same to the tables of saved floor plans so that applying one cannot bring a small table back.

nodes.label: Bookings still to seat take the legend's place in the rooms row
nodes.norm_label: bookings still to seat take the legend's place in the rooms row
nodes.rationale: Their own band over the map cost it 113 px on the till exactly while bookings were being placed. They now sit in the rooms row on one line that scrolls sideways (chips like 'Verdi · 3', the row saying '2 to seat'), and the colour legend comes back once all are seated.

nodes.label: One note counts several portions in the fixed-menu window
nodes.rationale: A note belongs to the plates it is written on, so it becomes one counted line under the dish instead of one line per plate; nothing changes on the server because the order already carried equal notes as a quantity.

nodes.label: Note line counter (light red -, plate count, light green +) before the note
nodes.rationale: + moves one of the dish's plain plates onto the note so the dish total does not move; only when every plate already has a note does it add one, if the course has room (a full course lights up as for a dish tap). - gives a plate back to the plain count and removes the line at the last, replacing the old X that removed the note.

nodes.label: Plates sharing a note read back as one line (from the check or the reloaded draft)
nodes.rationale: A menu read back from the check, or from the draft after a reload, arrives as a row per portion; plates with the same note are folded back into one counted line instead of one line each.
